tracks.name: Höljes Motorstadion
tracks.description: The 'Magic Weekend' in the Värmland forest. A fast tarmac start, a gravel climb over the famous jump and a joker cut through the trees, in front of the biggest crowd in rallycross.

tracks.name: Pista Automóvel de Montalegre
tracks.description: High in the hills of northern Portugal. A wide, fast gravel sweep, a tarmac hairpin and a joker that cuts across the infield.

tracks.name: Lånkebanen (Hell RX)
tracks.description: Norway's rallycross home near Trondheim airport. Long tarmac blasts, a gravel hairpin and a gravel joker on the outside.

tracks.name: Circuit de Lohéac
tracks.description: France's rallycross cathedral, with huge banks of fans. Mixed tarmac and dirt, a long joker loop and tight, bumpy hairpins.

tracks.name: Estering
tracks.description: A compact, fast German rallycross track. A long tarmac straight, gravel corners at either end and a short joker.
